create_tensorproperties_mixin: create a TensorProperties mixin class to store and broadcast batched tensor attributes with helper methods
use_tensoraccessor_getitem: use TensorAccessor to get or set a single batch element's tensor attribute by index on a TensorProperties object
broadcast_tensors_with_convert_to_tensor: convert multiple scalars or tensors to broadcasted tensors of the same batch dimension using convert_to_tensors_and_broadcast
format_scalar_to_tensor: format a Python scalar or list into a 1D PyTorch tensor with a specified dtype and device using format_tensor
gather_tensorproperties_by_batch_idx: gather and reshape all tensor properties of a TensorProperties object by batch indices using gather_props
